_comment: Run a JS/Python build or test runner offline. Highlights two Seatbelt-specific behaviors: AF_UNIX sockets are governed by the FILESYSTEM policy (worker IPC keeps working with the network fully denied), and nestedPty must stay true for anything that spawns a shell or pty.

process.commandLine: echo 'Offline build: UNIX-socket IPC + pty, no network'; echo '============================================================'; echo ''; rc=0; echo 'Test 1: AF_UNIX bind + connect inside readwritePaths...'; echo '  (build tools use these for worker IPC -- Seatbelt governs them by PATH,'; echo '   not by network policy, so they work even under a full network deny)'; if python3 -c "import socket,os; d='/tmp/mxc_build/ipc'; os.makedirs(d,exist_ok=True); p=d+'/w.sock'; os.path.exists(p) and os.unlink(p); s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM); s.bind(p); s.listen(1); c=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_STREAM); c.connect(p)" 2>/dev/null; then echo '  SUCCESS: worker IPC available'; else echo '  ERROR: AF_UNIX bind/connect failed'; rc=1; fi; echo ''; echo 'Test 2: TCP to the internet (denied)...'; if curl -s --max-time 5 --noproxy '*' https://example.com > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo '  ERROR: Should not have connected!'; rc=1; else echo '  SUCCESS: IP networking blocked while UNIX sockets still work'; fi; echo ''; echo 'Test 3: Allocating a pty (needs seatbelt.nestedPty)...'; if python3 -c "import os; m,s=os.openpty(); ok=os.isatty(s); os.close(m); os.close(s); assert ok" > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo '  SUCCESS: pty allocated'; else echo '  ERROR: pty allocation failed -- is nestedPty false?'; rc=1; fi; echo ''; echo 'Test 4: Reaching an agent socket outside the build tree (denied)...'; if [ -n "$SSH_AUTH_SOCK" ]; then echo '  ERROR: SSH_AUTH_SOCK leaked into the sandbox!'; rc=1; else echo '  SUCCESS: no agent socket path in the environment'; fi; echo ''; echo 'Test 5: process.env is applied on top of the cleared environment...'; echo "  PATH=$PATH"; echo "  HOME=$HOME  CI=$CI"; if [ "$CI" = 1 ] && case "$PATH" in /opt/homebrew/bin:*) true;; *) false;; esac; then echo '  SUCCESS: configured variables are visible'; else echo '  ERROR: process.env was not applied'; rc=1; fi; echo ''; echo '============================================================'; if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo 'Offline build test complete!'; else echo 'Offline build test FAILED'; fi; exit $rc
